PRESIDENT'S ORDER 17 OF 1979
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 17 OF 1979
NATIONAL AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (BASIS OF ELECTIONS) (AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th September, 1979]
No. F. 17(2)/79-Pub.-The
following Orders made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force)
Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A. Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the President and Chief Martial Law Administrator
is pleased to make the following Order t-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the
National and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections) (Amendment) Order,
1979.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 4, P. O. No. 14 of 1979.--In the National
and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections) Order, 1979 (P. O. No. 14 of
1979), hereinafter referred to as the said Order, in Article 4, for clause (3)
the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(3) Nothing in this Order
shall be deemed to affect the right to be declared elected to a seat in the
National Assembly or a Provincial Assembly of a person who is the only
contesting candidate for election to such seat or who has secured the highest
number of votes and has contested election to such seat-
(a) otherwise than as the
candidate or nominee of a political party, hereinafter referred to as an
independent candidate; or
(b) as the candidate or nominee
of a political party such as is referred to in paragraph (c) of clause (3) of
Article 6, or, as the case may be, in paragraph (b) of clause (3-A) of that
Article:
Provided that such person has
secured more than fifty percent. of the total number of valid votes cast at the
election."
3. Amendment of Article 6, P.O. No. 14 of 1979. In the said Order,
in Article 6,
(a) in clause (2), after the
brackets and figure "(3)" at the end, the words, commas, brackets,
figure and letter "or, as the case may be, in clause (3-A)" shall be
added;
(b) for clauses (3) and (4) the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(3) A political party shall
be entitled to such number of the seats in the National Assembly allocated to a
Province as bears to the total number of such seats the same proportion as the
total number of valid votes secured by that party at the election to such seats
bears to the aggregate of the valid votes cast at the said election excluding-
(a) the votes polled, or treated
as having been polled, by the independent candidates;
(b) theco nstituencies in which
there was only one contesting candidate; and
(e) the votes secured by a
political party which does not fulfil either of the following conditions,
namely :-
(i) the number of votes secured
by it throughout Pakistan at the election to the seats in the National Assembly
is not less than five percent. of the aggregate of the valid votes cast at the
said election; or
(ii) not less than three of its
candidates or nominees have become entitled to be declared elected to the seats
in the National Assembly:
Provided that no political party
such as is referred to in paragraph (c) shall be entitled to any such seat.
(3-A) A political party shall be
entitled to such number of the seats in the Provincial Assembly of a Province
as bears to the total number of such seats the same proportion as the total
number of valid votes secured by that party bears to the aggregate of the valid
votes cast at the election, excluding-
(a) the votes polled, or treated
as having been polled, by the independent candidates;
(b) the votes secured by a
political party which has secured less than five percent. of the said
aggregate; and
(c) the constituencies in which
there was only one contesting candidate:
Provided that no political party
such as is referred to in paragraph (b) shall be entitled to any such seat.
